sitstand_fast_5499.description: Sit/stand with a 0.4 s posture ramp (fine-tune of sitstand_4000). Deterministic transition times (32 envs): to seated 0.32 s median / 0.38 s max, to standing 0.26 / 0.28 s (previous policy 1.0 / 2.14 and 0.62 / 2.02); 100 % reached, 0 falls; standing tilt median 1.3 deg.

run_v3_4250.description: Full-collision runner with the mirror loss, before the +-0.6 m/s push stage collapsed it: 0.60 m/s at the 0.7 command (run v2: 0.49), 0 falls, air-time L/R 0.91 (32 envs, deterministic).

standup_9999.description: Get-up + standing hold (port of Pollen's StandUp, two-phase entropy 0.01/0.001, 10000 its). Deterministic, 32 envs, no pushes, in the full-collision walk scene: stands from face down / face up / side / random / real fall bank 100 %, time to stand 0.30-0.56 s median, 0 re-falls; standing hold 100 %. With 1.0 m/s shoves every 1.5 s (phase-1 ckpt): knocked down each time, back up each time.
standup_9999.role: frozen recovery expert for the VelStand distillation; standalone fallback balance policy

velstand_21495.description: ONE walking policy with balance at zero speed and fall recovery (Pollen's VelStand recipe: PPO warm-started from walk v4 + fallen-gated behaviour cloning from standup_9999, zero-command upright frames cloned from the expert too, upright anchor to walk v4). Deterministic: stands at 0.116 m at zero command (walk v4 crouched to 0.073), gets up from face down / face up / side / random / real fall bank 100 % (0.28-0.56 s median, re-falls 3-9 %), walks 0.3 m/s with air-time L/R 0.95. 1.0 m/s shoves every 1.5 s still topple it; it gets back up each time (84 % standing at the end of 6 s).
velstand_21495.role: the walk policy to deploy (replaces walk_allcoll_16498 / walk v3 / walk v4)

run_v3_5999.description: Full-collision runner with the mirror loss, take 2 (restarted from 4250 with pushes held at +-0.3). Deterministic, 32 envs: achieved 0.27 / 0.45 / 0.59 / 0.63 / 0.61 m/s at commands 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.7 / 0.9 / 1.1 (run v2: 0.23 / 0.40 / 0.49 / 0.45 / 0.33), falls 0 / 0 / 0 / 3 / 9 %, air-time L/R 0.86-1.01. Peak 0.63 m/s; knee/ankle servos ride the HD1910 speed limit (11.3-11.4 of 11.9 rad/s).
run_v3_5999.role: the run policy to deploy (replaces run_allcoll_4498); sprint-max warm start

sprint_max_7998.description: Top-speed runner: run v3 fine-tuned with a direct forward-speed reward (weight 15), command pinned 1.0-1.4, battery sampled 7.4-8.4 V. Deterministic, 32 envs: 1.19 / 1.14 / 1.05 / 1.11 m/s at commands 0.7 / 1.0 / 1.2 / 1.4 (falls 0 / 0 / 0 / 9 %), 1.10-1.12 m/s in the run v3 env (7.4-8.0 V); net ground displacement 1.13 m/s, trunk 0.118 m, pitch -3 deg; air-time L/R 0.98-1.00. Knee/ankle peaks 12-13.6 rad/s (the servo's no-load speed at 7.4-8.4 V is 11.9-13.5), torque at the 1.07 N.m cap. It runs flat out regardless of the command magnitude; use run_v3_5999 for commanded speeds below 0.6.

roulade_6000.description: Front flip = Pollen's roulade (forward roll over the flat top of the head, back onto the feet); port of their run-5 recipe, entropy 0.001, 8000 its, selected by landing rate. Deterministic standing start: 32-env selection block 100 % complete+standing; fresh 96-env confirmation block 96.9 % complete (>=330 deg over the head) AND standing at the end, 100 % standing at the end, median rotation 349 deg, final tilt 9 deg. Other checkpoints on the same 96 block: 8000 95.8 %, 7000 91.7 %, 4000 85.4 %.
